reviews.reason: useNotificationBellController已拥有inbox请求、打开状态、ResizeObserver与分栏几何；NotificationBell只渲染一个通知Menu/PopupWorkspace内channel与message两pane及所属交互。没有第二个请求owner、导出混合常量或render内定义组件type；这个单一inbox视图的长度不证明状态/权限/接口归属缺陷。 Reassessed 2026-11-03: Channel read-all and message unread controls now consume their individual grants; opening an owned unread message still uses authenticated self-service. The existing inbox controller and two-pane popup own requests and geometry.
